values.summary: Inventory historical estimation evidence, define v2-owned typed joins and advisory forecasts, prove sparse/unknown/drift behavior and no enforcement, integrate accepted estimates and terminal actuals, then measure cycle-time and calibration against retained baselines.

steps.action: Define typed observations, forecasts, outcomes, sufficiency gates, and the exact estimation_contracts integration target
Implement deterministic cohorts, advisory SPP integration, terminal actuals, backtests, and drift handling
Run the exact no-tests-fail integration target, cycle-time comparison, and exact-revision review

invariants: Unknown observations remain unknown rather than zero
Every forecast field retains source provenance and model/platform era
The target issue cannot leak its own future actuals into its cohort
Estimates never enforce completion, stopping, phase changes, or acceptance
Static planning profiles remain an explicit fallback until measured promotion
risks: Sparse or selected session data produces false confidence
Model or workflow drift invalidates historical token and duration cohorts
Multi-session and interrupted work is double-counted or omitted
Sensitive transcript content leaks into durable evidence
A speedup removes a truthful lifecycle gate

advisory.operator_rationale: No current-era comparable cohort exists; retain the static PlanningProfile fallback as advisory only until terminal actuals accumulate.

stop_conditions: WP-02A timing and lane topology is unstable
Joined field provenance cannot be established
Target-actual leakage or transcript-content retention is observed
Estimator output changes lifecycle state or execution limits
replan_triggers: Codex session schema or token accounting era changes
C-SDLC v2 cards or closeout schemas change
CI/PVF topology materially changes cohort comparability
Backtests fail to outperform or calibrate against static and historical baselines
